pages.title: Seal-carvers
text: “Spirit goes where it is asked politely and stays where it is fed.”

pages.title: Who they are
text: The Seal-carvers cut blank seals by the thousand before the Cut, and asked for far too much. A seal is a polite request carved in stone; a brazier is the meal. Their craft is **seals and rites**.
Their camps stand in **dark forests**, and a second camp keeps the old road in the March highlands.

pages.title: What they want
text: Their reagent is the **Spirit Shard**, worth **+8** standing at their hearth.
They also favour a Blank Seal or any element seal: **+3** each. Any other food is worth **+1**, and a charged Pulse Cell **+2 for every 10 Pulse**, up to +8.
Remember the hearth takes at most **60** standing a day from offerings; see [Tribes and standing](standing).

pages.title: What the Elder trades
text: **Guest**: 2 Spirit Shards for a Blank Seal; 4 Echo Shards for 4 Ritual Chalk.
**Friend**: a Blank Seal and 2 Spirit Shards for a Spirit Seal; 3 Attuned Echo and 2 Spirit Shards for the Rite Tablet: Still Night.
**Kin**: 3 Bound Echo for a Ritual Brazier; 4 Bound Echo for a Wake Bell.

pages.title: Their Mark and totem
text: At **Voice** the Elder gives you the Seal-carvers' Tribe Mark. Craft it with a {item:tribalpower:resonance_totem_spirit} and two Spiritweave into their [Kinship Totem](kinship_totem).
Beside a Pulse Resonator it is one more voice; beside a station it lends **Spirit**.
Their Friend trade for a Rite Tablet is a shortcut past the hunt for its reagents. They are also the only tribe that sells a **Wake Bell**.
Kin of the Seal-carvers carry their [boon](tribe_boons): your charms ask **half** the Pulse.
